title: New task files into the project you have open
description: Opening a project and pressing New task used to ask which project to file into, with the one you were already reading pre-filled. The question is gone: the task lands in the project you are standing in, and the dialog says which one that is.
items: Where the task will be filed is still named in the dialog — it is a line to read now, not a dropdown to answer
For a team leader the department follows the project too, instead of starting on the first department they lead
Changing the department brings the picker back, since the project belonged to the department just left
The picker still appears where there is no project to follow: My tasks, the QA queue, and the quick add on the home page
